title: Abba Carriage House
meta_description: Find the perfect Rosemary Beach, FL vacation rental at Abba Carriage House, a luxury 1-bed, 1-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 4 guests, this carriage house offers all the luxury amenities Rosemary Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Directly Next to Coquina Pool -Gulf Side of Rosemary Beach -Steps to Beach and Eastern Green -2 Adult Bikes **Cottage and Carriage House are available to be booked separately except during peak/high season** Welcome to your luxurious beach retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach! This stunning carriage house, featuring a full kitchen, king bedroom, and living area with a queen sleeper sofa, accommodating up to 4 guests. For ultimate relaxation, indulge in the amenities of the Rosemary Beach community, including access to the Coquina Pool next door, where you can bask in the Florida sun from 9 am to 9 pm daily. Escape to luxury and tranquility at this exquisite beach rental, where every detail has been thoughtfully curated for your enjoyment. Book your stay today and experience the beauty of Rosemary Beach like never before. Sleeping Arrangements Carriage House -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Queen Sleeper Sofa In Living Area **Cottage and Carriage House are available to be booked separately except during peak/high season**
